messages:
maria_cs: Quick flag Halcyon Labs onboarding showing steady traffic (~45 rps) but their LLM latency-sensitive flows (chat + function-calling) spike intermittently. Renewal touch in 12 days, CSM worried about SLA. Thinking a two-pronged pilot: (A) lightweight int8 for short interactions and int4 experiment for low-criticality batch jobs, (B) dynamic routing by SLO and token-length with KV prefix cache for repeated instructions. Want to present conservative savings estimate to customer: 25-50% cost reduction depending on mix. Thoughts?

sam_se: Can we avoid int4 for interactive sessions? Int4 can be pretty noisy for function-calling. Recommend int4 only for non-interactive embeddings and background summarization. For chat: int8 + smart routing by token count and model confidence.

lee_ml: Did a small proof-of-concept on their sample set (30 chats, 40 doc summarizations). Int8: small ROUGE/EM sway but within acceptable limits for their persona. Int4: works for embeddings (similar cosine) and short summarization (~<150 tokens) with minor hallucination uptick. I'll produce a confusion table and precision-recall deltas by EOD.

jordan_eng: I'll draft routing rules and a safe canary. Suggest start with 3% traffic to int8-compact, 1% to int4-batch, monitor p99, model_confidence, and end-to-end success (function-call integrity). Example policy snippet: ```routing: - id: s1_match_short
  cond: request.tokens <= 512 and request.metadata.slo == "interactive"
  target: redwood-compact-int8
  weight: 3
- id: s2_batch_int4
  cond: request.metadata.job_type == "background"
  target: redwood-compact-int4
  weight: 1``` Also add fallback: if model_confidence < 0.55 OR function_call_failed then route to redwood-full and mark for audit.

maria_cs: Good. Renewal lead asked for a one-pager showing rollback plan & timelines. Can we outline runbook bullets here?

jordan_eng: Runbook (short): 1) Start canary (3% int8 / 1% int4) for 72h. 2) Monitor: p50/p95/p99 latency, token_cost, model_confidence, function_call_success_rate, semantic-quality-check (sampled). 3) Auto-rollback triggers: quality drop > 2 ROUGE points OR function_call_failure delta > 5% OR p99 increase > 30%. 4) Escalation: if auto-rollback fires, page infra oncall and CS lead. 5) Post-mortem in 48h.

lee_ml: I'll provide an eval harness with A/B paired scoring and a sampled human review set (40 pairs) so we can detect subtle changes to intent preservation.

sam_se: One more engineering note: enable prefix KV cache for chat to cut repeated prompt tokens (we saw 12% token reduction in a previous pilot). Also set batching window for background jobs to 200ms to boost int4 throughput.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary request queued. Start window 2025-06-02T09:00Z. Watch metrics: p50/p95/p99, token_cost, function_call_success, model_confidence. Auto-rollback thresholds: quality_drop > 2 ROUGE, function_call_failure +5%, p99 up +30%.

maria_cs: I'll draft the renewal-facing note: explain we're prioritizing quality for interactive flows, testing aggressive cost optimizations only on background jobs, and we have rollback/alert safeguards. Also offering a joint enablement session to show embedding/batch use-cases post-pilot.

jordan_eng: I'll prepare the canary config and a short script to inject synthetic long-tail traffic to exercise tail latency. Will post links to the staging dashboard when ready.

lee_ml: One blocker: need sanitized long-doc samples for human eval. Maria, can you share the top 20 docs (sanitized) and 100 chat transcripts?

maria_cs: Yes, I'll upload sanitized artifacts to the secure bucket and DM the link. Also will schedule a 30-min sync with Halcyon to set expectations.

sam_se: sgtm. If pilot results match our estimates we can propose a staged cost share incentive for renewal to show ROI.

maria_cs: Thanks team 44d. Target decision to expand in 10 days based on pilot outcomes. I'll log the plan in the renewal playbook and tag renewal_lead.
